description: This file contains unit tests for the WakeWords class in the ai.openclaw.app package. It tests parsing and sanitizing wake word lists, as well as detecting changes in the list.

classes.name: WakeWordsTest
classes.description: A test class containing unit tests for WakeWords parsing and sanitization functions.

methods.name: parseCommaSeparatedTrimsAndDropsEmpty
methods.description: Tests that the parseCommaSeparated method correctly trims whitespace and drops empty entries.

methods.name: sanitizeTrimsCapsAndFallsBack
methods.description: Tests sanitization of wake words, including trimming, capital case fallback, and length limits.

methods.name: sanitizeLimitsWordCount
methods.description: Tests that the sanitize method limits the number of wake words to maxWords.

methods.name: parseIfChangedSkipsWhenUnchanged
methods.description: Tests that parseIfChanged returns null when the input list has not changed.

methods.name: parseIfChangedReturnsUpdatedList
methods.description: Tests that parseIfChanged returns a new list when the wake words have changed.
